svg.text: STOP2 PPK comparison: NINA DSR sleep vs reset-held
blue: DSR Sleep/System-OFF candidate, mean 394 uA
Raw current, first 100 ms, clipped at 5 mA
DSR sleep: mean 394.3 uA, median 283.1 uA, strongest FFT ~1919.8 Hz, pulse autocorr lag ~1.57 ms.
Reset-held: mean 586.8 uA, median 331.1 uA, strongest FFT ~1935.7 Hz plus strong ~963 Hz, pulse autocorr lag ~1.04 ms.
Changing only NINA resident policy changed both baseline and pulse structure, so the NINA path is implicated.
